content.title: Rare Earth Stocks Jump On Trump Stake In USA Rare Earth
content.summary: USA Rare Earth stock soared early Monday on news that the Trump administration will purchase a 10% stake as part of $1.6 billion in financing to help the Stillwater, Okla., company build out its mine-to-magnet supply chain.  Other rare earth stocks also jumped, including MP Materials, in which the U.S. government has already taken a stake.  Rare earth stocks including NioCorp Developments, Critical Metals, Energy Fuels and American Resources rallied along with broader critical minerals plays like United States Antimony and Westwater Resources, a graphite play.

content.title: Rare Earth Stocks Revive After China Slams Trump's Venezuela Intervention
content.summary: Rare earth stocks moved higher Monday after Beijing's denunciation of President Trump's intervention in Venezuela underscored the urgency of setting up a non-China supply chain for rare earth magnets critical for the U.S. military.  MP Materials, USA Rare Earth, American Resources, NioCorp Developments were among stocks to post gains.  Until Friday, the once red-hot rare-earth sector turned ice cold over the past few months, particularly after President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed to meet in South Korea in October, and reached some accommodation over rare-earth access.
